title: Oscars: Ireland Selects Damian McCann’s Heist Thriller ‘Aontas’ for International Feature Race
content:
ByAlex Ritman

“Aontas,” the Irish-language heist thriller from director Damian McCann, has been chosen as Ireland’s entry for the best international feature film category at the 2027 Academy Awards.

The film was selected by the Irish Film & TV Academy (IFTA) and a committee including “Evil Dead Rise” director Lee Cronin, “Derry Girls” creator Lisa McGee, BAFTA-nominated director Brian Kirk (“Game of Thrones), BAFTA nominated director Kathryn Ferguson (“Nothing Compares”), Emmy-winning actress and filmmaker Aisha Tyler (“Friends”), actress Fionnuala Flaherty (“Kneecap”) and IFTA chief executive Áine Moriarty.

Told in reverse chronology, “Aontas” follows three unlikely thieves, led by a woman on the verge of a breakdown, who rob a rural Irish bank. Opening in the tragic aftermath of the heist-gone-wrong. What starts as a poorly executed robbery becomes a portrait of a wilful woman trapped in her own past. It stars Carrie Crowley (“The Quiet Girl “), Bríd Brennan, Eva-Jane Gaffney, Seán T. Ó Meallaigh, Marcus Lamb and Art Parkinson.

Written by Sarah Gordon and McCann, “Aontas” was produced by Órfhlaith Ní Chearnaigh and Christopher Myers for Púca Pictures, with funding from TG4, BBC Gaeilge and Northern Ireland Screen’s Irish Language Broadcast Fund, and support from Yellowmoon.

“It is such an honour that ‘Aontas’ has been selected to represent Ireland at the 99th Academy Awards. Thank you so much to IFTA and to the committee for their support. I was bringing some soggy washing in out of the rain when the news arrived – what a turnaround of a day,” said McCann.

“We’ve been overwhelmed by the film’s journey so far – what feels like a very specifically Irish story seems to have really resonated with International audiences. My co-writer Sarah Gordon and I wrote the script in the attic of our house and we shot over 18 rainy days in the Glens of Antrim. We could never have imagined that this is where the journey might take us, but it’s a testament to the staggering graft and boundless optimism of our cast and crew.”

Added IFTA Chief Executive Moriarty: “IFTA is delighted to announce that ‘Aontas’ will represent Ireland in the upcoming International Feature Film category at theOscars. What an intriguing and clever twist on the classic bank heist narrative, with powerful female performances at its core by Carrie Crowley, Bríd Brennan and Eva-Jane Gaffney. This wonderful Irish language film is resonating with audiences worldwide – congratulations to the filmmakers, cast and crew.”

“Aontas” follows int he recent footsteps of 2023’s “The Quiet Girl,” which became Ireland’s first ever  Oscar nominee for international feature film, and 2024’s “Kneecap,” which was Oscar shortlisted.
title_zh: 奧斯卡：愛爾蘭選擇達米安·麥肯(Damian McCann)的搶劫驚悚片《Aontas》(Aontas)參加國際影片競賽。
content_zh:
由亞歷克斯·瑞特曼（Alex Ritman）報導

愛爾蘭語的搶劫驚悚片《Aontas》（《Aontas》）由導演達米安·麥肯（Damian McCann）執導，已被選為愛爾蘭在2027年奧斯卡金像獎最佳國際影片類別的參賽作品。

該片由愛爾蘭電影與電視學院（Irish Film & TV Academy，IFTA）及包括《惡靈古堡：崛起》（Evil Dead Rise）導演李·克羅寧（Lee Cronin）、《德里女孩》（Derry Girls）創作者莉莎·麥基（Lisa McGee）、英國電影與電視藝術學院（BAFTA）提名導演布萊恩·柯克（Brian Kirk， 《權力的遊戲》）、BAFTA提名導演凱瑟琳·弗格森（Kathryn Ferguson，《無可比擬》）、艾美獎得主及導演艾莎·泰勒（Aisha Tyler，《老友記》）、女演員芬努拉·弗拉赫提（Fionnuala Flaherty，《膝蓋》）以及IFTA首席執行官艾妮·莫里亞提（Áine Moriarty）組成的委員會選出。

《Aontas》（《Aontas》）以倒敘的方式講述了三名不太可能的盜賊的故事，他們由一位即將崩潰的女性領導，搶劫了一家位於愛爾蘭鄉村的銀行。故事開場於搶劫失敗後的悲劇後果，原本執行不佳的搶劫變成了一幅被困在自己過去的意志堅定女性的肖像。影片主演包括凱莉·克勞利（Carrie Crowley，《安靜的女孩》）、布里德·布倫南（Bríd Brennan）、艾娃·簡·加夫尼（Eva-Jane Gaffney）、肖恩·T·奧梅拉（Seán T. Ó Meallaigh）、馬庫斯·蘭姆（Marcus Lamb）和阿特·帕金森（Art Parkinson）。

《Aontas》（《Aontas》）的劇本由莎拉·戈登（Sarah Gordon）和麥肯共同撰寫，製作由奧爾法·尼·切納赫（Órfhlaith Ní Chearnaigh）和克里斯托弗·邁爾斯（Christopher Myers）為Púca Pictures製作，並獲得TG4、BBC Gaeilge和北愛爾蘭影像基金的資助，以及Yellowmoon的支持。

麥肯表示：“能夠讓《Aontas》（《Aontas》）代表愛爾蘭參加第99屆奧斯卡金像獎，真是莫大的榮幸。非常感謝IFTA和委員會的支持。當消息傳來時，我正把一些潮濕的衣物從雨中拿進來——真是一個驚人的轉折。”

他補充道：“我們對這部電影的旅程感到驚喜——這個看似非常具愛爾蘭特色的故事似乎真的引起了國際觀眾的共鳴。我和我的共同編劇莎拉·戈登在我們家的閣樓上寫了劇本，並在安特里姆山谷的18個雨天拍攝。我們從未想過旅程會帶我們到這裡，但這證明了我們演員和工作人員的驚人努力和無限樂觀。”

IFTA首席執行官莫里亞提補充道：“IFTA很高興宣布《Aontas》（《Aontas》）將代表愛爾蘭參加即將舉行的奧斯卡最佳國際影片類別。這是一個對經典銀行搶劫故事的有趣而巧妙的扭轉，凱莉·克勞利、布里德·布倫南和艾娃·簡·加夫尼的強大女性表演是其核心。這部精彩的愛爾蘭語電影正在全球觀眾中引起共鳴——恭喜所有的電影製作人、演員和工作人員。”

《Aontas》（《Aontas》）緊隨2023年的《安靜的女孩》（The Quiet Girl）之後，該片成為愛爾蘭首部奧斯卡最佳國際影片提名作品，以及2024年的《膝蓋》（Kneecap），該片曾入圍奧斯卡短名單。
